moderation_reports_one_target.name: moderation_reports_one_target
moderation_reports_one_target.value: ("moderation_reports"."listing_id" IS NOT NULL)::int + ("moderation_reports"."reported_user_id" IS NOT NULL)::int = 1

deals_accepted_at_valid.name: deals_accepted_at_valid
deals_accepted_at_valid.value: ("deals"."status" NOT IN ('accepted','completed') OR "deals"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("deals"."accepted_at" IS NULL OR "deals"."status" IN ('accepted','completed','cancelled'))

deals_completion_valid.name: deals_completion_valid
deals_completion_valid.value:
"deals"."completed_at" IS NULL OR ("deals"."status" = 'completed' AND
        "deals"."closing_amount" IS NOT NULL AND "deals"."closing_currency" IS NOT NULL AND
        "deals"."closing_agreed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "deals"."buyer_confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND
        "deals"."seller_confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "deals"."closing_disputed_by" IS NULL)

deal_document_request_status_valid.name: deal_document_request_status_valid
deal_document_request_status_valid.value:
("deal_document_requests"."status" = 'requested' AND "deal_document_requests"."document_id" IS NULL AND "deal_document_requests"."reviewed_by" IS NULL AND "deal_document_requests"."reviewed_at" IS NULL)
    OR ("deal_document_requests"."status" = 'submitted' AND "deal_document_requests"."document_id" IS NOT NULL AND "deal_document_requests"."reviewed_by" IS NULL AND "deal_document_requests"."reviewed_at" IS NULL)
    OR ("deal_document_requests"."status" IN ('under_review','accepted','changes_requested') AND "deal_document_requests"."document_id" IS NOT NULL AND "deal_document_requests"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "deal_document_requests"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL)

listing_sold_state_valid.name: listing_sold_state_valid
listing_sold_state_valid.value:
("business_listings"."status"::text = 'sold') = ("business_listings"."sold_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("business_listings"."public_sale_price" IS NULL) = ("business_listings"."public_sale_currency" IS NULL)
        AND ("business_listings"."public_sale_price" IS NULL OR ("business_listings"."sold_at" IS NOT NULL AND "business_listings"."public_sale_price" > 0))

business_listings_financials_nonnegative.name: business_listings_financials_nonnegative
business_listings_financials_nonnegative.value: ("business_listings"."asking_price" IS NULL OR "business_listings"."asking_price" >= 0) AND ("business_listings"."annual_revenue" IS NULL OR "business_listings"."annual_revenue" >= 0) AND ("business_listings"."ebitda" IS NULL OR "business_listings"."ebitda" >= 0)
